messages.subject: Project Marlin - board approval done
messages.plaintextBody:
Sarah, James,

The board met this afternoon and approved the Transaction and all Transaction Documents, including the £1.5m Company warranty cap. Written shareholder resolutions (special - adopt new articles; ordinary - authority to allot and dis-apply pre-emption) are out for signature and should be back tomorrow. Signed board minutes to follow.

Priya
